'''Victor Hugo Moll''' (born 1956) is a Chilean American mathematician specializing in analysis.

Moll studied at the [[Universidad Técnica Federico Santa María]] and at the [[New York University]] with a master's degree in 1982 and a doctorate in 1984 with [[Henry P. McKean]] (''Stability in the Large for Solitary Wave Solutions to McKean's Nerve Conduction Caricature'').<ref name="MGP"/> He was a post-doctoral student at [[Temple University]] and became an assistant professor in 1986 and an associate professor in 1992 and in 2001 Professor at [[Tulane University]].

In 1990–1991, he was a visiting professor at the [[University of Utah]], in 1999 at the [[Universidad Técnica Federico Santa María]] in [[Valparaíso]], and in 1995 a visiting scientist at the [[Courant Institute of Mathematical Sciences]] of New York University.

He deals with classical analysis, symbolic arithmetic and [[experimental mathematics]], special functions and number theory.

== Projects ==
Inspired by a 1988 paper in which {{ill|Ilan Vardi|de}} proved several integrals in 
''[[Table of Integrals, Series, and Products]]'',<ref name="Vardi_1988"/> a well-known comprehensive table of integrals originally compiled by the Russian mathematicians [[Iosif Moiseevich Ryzhik]] (Russian: Иосиф Моисеевич Рыжик) and [[Izrail Solomonovich Gradshteyn]] (Израиль Соломонович Градштейн) in 1943 and subsequently expanded and translated into several languages, Victor Moll and [[George Boros]] started a project to prove all integrals listed in ''Gradshteyn and Ryzhik'' and add additional commentary and references.<ref name="Moll_2010"/> In the foreword of the book ''Irresistible Integrals'' (2004), they wrote:<ref name="Boros_2004"/>
{{blockquote|It took a short time to realize that this task was monumental.}}
Nevertheless, the efforts have resulted in about 900<!-- count of entries in articles 1-30: 10+5+8+44+10+65+30+7+45+76+52+6+21+1+(12[-1])+36+36+(7[+3])+42+26+75+36+54+10+18+41+37+17+(19[+16])+51=897[+18] --> entries from ''Gradshteyn and Ryzhik'' discussed in a series of more than 30 articles<!--<ref name="Moll_Scientia_Part_29"/><ref name="Moll_Scientia_Part_30"/><ref name="Moll_Scientia_Part_X1"/> --> of which papers 1 to 28<!--<ref name="Moll_Paper_1"/><ref name="Moll_Scientia_Part_1"/><ref name="Moll_Paper_2"/><ref name="Moll_Scientia_Part_2"/><ref name="Moll_Paper_3"/><ref name="Moll_Scientia_Part_3"/><ref name="Moll_Paper_4"/><ref name="Moll_Scientia_Part_4"/><ref name="Moll_Scientia_Part_5"/><ref name="Moll_Scientia_Part_6"/><ref name="Moll_Scientia_Part_7"/><ref name="Moll_Scientia_Part_8"/><ref name="Moll_Scientia_Part_9"/><ref name="Moll_Paper_10"/><ref name="Moll_Scientia_Part_10"/><ref name="Moll_Scientia_Part_11"/><ref name="Moll_Scientia_Part_12"/><ref name="Moll_Scientia_Part_13"/><ref name="Moll_Scientia_Part_14"/><ref name="Moll_Scientia_Part_15"/><ref name="Moll_Scientia_Part_16"/><ref name="Moll_Scientia_Part_17"/><ref name="Moll_Scientia_Part_18"/><ref name="Moll_Scientia_Part_19"/><ref name="Moll_Scientia_Part_20"/><ref name="Moll_Scientia_Part_21"/><ref name="Moll_Scientia_Part_22"/><ref name="Moll_Scientia_Part_23"/><ref name="Moll_Scientia_Part_24"/><ref name="Moll_Scientia_Part_25"/><ref name="Moll_Scientia_Part_26"/><ref name="Moll_Scientia_Part_27"/><ref name="Moll_Scientia_Part_28"/> --> have been published in issues 14 to 26<!-- except for 24 --> of [[Scientia (UTFSM journal)|Scientia]], [[Universidad Técnica Federico Santa María]] (UTFSM), between 2007 and 2015<ref name="Moll_Scientia"/> and compiled into a two-volume book series ''Special Integrals of Gradshteyn and Ryzhik: the Proofs'' (2014–2015).<ref name="Moll_SIGR1_2014"/><ref name="Moll_SIGR2_2015"/> Moll also assisted [[Daniel Zwillinger]] editing the eighth English edition of [[Gradshteyn and Ryzhik]] in 2014.<ref name="Zwillinger_2014"/>

Moll also took on the task to revise and expand the classical landmark work "[[A Course of Modern Analysis]]" by [[Whittaker and Watson]], which was originally published in 1902 and last revised in 1927, to publish a new edition in 2021.

== Publications ==
* [http://www.ams.org/notices/200203/index.html ''The evaluation of integrals, a personal story'', Notices AMS, 2002, No. 3]
* with Henry McKean ''Elliptic Curves: function theory, geometry, arithmetic'', Cambridge University Press, 1997
* ''Numbers and functions: from a classical-experimental mathematician’s point of view'', AMS, 2012
* Editor with Tewodros Amdeberhan ''Tapas in experimental mathematics'', AMS Special Session on Experimental Mathematics, January 5, 2007, New Orleans, Louisiana, AMS, 2008
* Editor with Tewodros Amdeberhan, Luis A. Medina ''Gems in experimental mathematics'', AMS Special Session, Experimental Mathematics, January 5, 2009, Washington, DC, AMS, 2010
* with George Boros ''Irresistible Integrals: Symbolics, Analysis and Experiments in the Evaluation of Integrals'', Cambridge University Press, 2004.
* [[A Course of Modern Analysis]], 2021
